eaa87cc5c5eb8c81e62e7be77cf56c79f1a72809.sourceText: 因此，**导航时会读取二维图和PCD；实时匹配的是“当前三维点云与保存的三维PCD”。** 不是把PCD与二维图片互相匹配，也不是每帧先存一份PCD再匹配。当前small_gicp按约0.5 s的定时器处理累计点云，只有匹配收敛才更新结果；这不保证每0.5 s都得到正确定位。常规导航不启动slam_toolbox和这个二维扫描转换节点，也没有用它们进行实时二维地图匹配。接线见[slam_launch.py](/home/tungchiahui/UserFolder/MySource/ysu2026_rm_sentry/ysu2026_rm_sentry_nav/src/pb2025_sentry_nav/pb2025_nav_bringup/launch/slam_launch.py:126)、[localization_launch.py](/home/tungchiahui/UserFolder/MySource/ysu2026_rm_sentry/ysu2026_rm_sentry_nav/src/pb2025_sentry_nav/pb2025_nav_bringup/launch/localization_launch.py:135)。
eaa87cc5c5eb8c81e62e7be77cf56c79f1a72809.translatedText: Therefore,**During navigation, the 2D map and PCD are read; what is matched in real time is the “current 3D point cloud and the saved 3D PCD\.”** It is not matching the PCD with a 2D image, nor saving a copy of the PCD each frame before matching\. The current small_gicp processes the accumulated point cloud on a timer of about 0\.5 s, and updates the result only when matching converges; this does not guarantee correct localization every 0\.5 s\. Normal navigation does not start slam_toolbox or this 2D scan conversion node, nor does it use them for real\-time 2D map matching\. For wiring, see[slam_launch.py](/home/tungchiahui/UserFolder/MySource/ysu2026_rm_sentry/ysu2026_rm_sentry_nav/src/pb2025_sentry_nav/pb2025_nav_bringup/launch/slam_launch.py:126)、[localization_launch.py](/home/tungchiahui/UserFolder/MySource/ysu2026_rm_sentry/ysu2026_rm_sentry_nav/src/pb2025_sentry_nav/pb2025_nav_bringup/launch/localization_launch.py:135)\.
